prerequisites: Programming skills and knowledge of the C language, in particular the ability to develop simple C programs, using conditional and iterative constructs, simple and structured data types, standard I/O, text files and functions.
Syntax, data types and basic constructs of the C language.
Knowledge of simple (int, float, double, char) and structured (vectors, struct) data types.
Knowledge and understanding of pointers and pointer arithmetic.
Knowledge of functions and understanding of the parameter passing mechanism.
Knowledge of dynamic memory management (allocation and de-allocation of memory)
Knowledge of linked lists in C (implemented by records and pointers) and their management

learning_outcomes.text: At the end of the course the student will have a good understanding of algorithms, data structures and their implementation in C for solving problems of medium difficulty. He will also have a good understanding of the concept of computational complexity and of the main methods for its computation.
formulate algorithms for solving problems of medium difficulty, making choices also in consideration of the computational complexity of the algorithms
apply the concepts learned in the development of C and Python programs
evaluate the pros and cons of using a specific algorithm to solve a given problem
evaluate the computational complexity of the algorithms

At the end of the course, the student will have acquired adequate linguistic skills in relation to the course content, so that it can be fully understood by an interlocutor with adequate technical knowledge and to transmit the essential concepts even to a non technically competent interlocutor.

At the end of the course, the student should have the ability to deepen his knowledge in the field of algorithm and data structure design. The student will be able to independently extend his/her algorithm design skills.

syllabus_topics: Elements of modularization: fundamental concepts and implementation in C
Notes on the quality of the Software
Fundamental algorithms and their implementation in C
Search and sort algorithms. Study of the algorithms and implementation in C
Algorithms and data structures for manipulating graphs and trees. Study of the algorithms and implementation in C
Introduction to the Python programming language.
assessment_rules: The exam consists of a written test and an oral test. If the oral exam is evaluated NOT SUFFICIENT, the entire exam will be considered insufficient. If the student requests an oral evaluation after the written test, the written test will contribute 70% and the oral test (if sufficient) 30% to the final mark. An ongoing test can be taken; if sufficient (at least 18/30), it allows a reduced final exam not covering already assessed topics. This opportunity is available until the January-February session.
